hazards.title: Spring @Transactional Self-Invocation Proxy Bypass
hazards.description: Calling `this.reserveStock()` internally bypasses the Spring CGLIB/JDK proxy. `@Transactional(propagation = Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW)` is silently ignored, risking partial inventory deductions on crash.
hazards.remedy: Inject self (`@Lazy OrderService self`) or extract stock reservation into a separate Spring bean.

hazards.title: Hibernate N+1 Query Cascade on Products List
hazards.description: Fetching 100 orders triggers 101 separate SELECT queries to PostgreSQL for item rows due to FetchType.LAZY in loop.

idiomExplainers.summary: Spring applies transactional boundaries by wrapping beans in dynamic proxies. Direct intra-class method calls (`this.method()`) skip the proxy.
idiomExplainers.whyItMatters: Nested transactions or rollbacks defined on internal helper methods will fail to trigger.
idiomExplainers.goRule: Always invoke transactional methods through injected Spring beans, never `this.`.
